story.iWant: a runner that executes strategies in isolated subprocesses
story.soThat: rustybt and Backtrader don't conflict during execution

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: run_rustybt_strategy() executes rustybt strategy in subprocess
run_backtrader_strategy() executes Backtrader strategy in subprocess
Subprocess execution uses sys.executable for same Python interpreter
Runners capture stdout/stderr with text=True, capture_output=True
Integration test executes simple strategy in both frameworks

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Execute rustybt and Backtrader in separate processes. Prevents dependency conflicts. Clean environment isolation.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Decision: Run frameworks in separate subprocesses. Rationale: Prevents import conflicts, clean isolation.

artifact.reason: Strategies must extend ValidatedStrategy base classes
Backtrader strategies use this base class
Will need to export runner functions

constraints.constraint: Use sys.executable to ensure same Python interpreter
Never import both frameworks in same process
Default timeout 300 seconds, configurable per call
JSON serialize params dict for command line

interface.name: run_rustybt_strategy
interface.signature: def run_rustybt_strategy(strategy_module: str, data_path: Path, output_log: Path, params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: int = 300) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess

interface.name: run_backtrader_strategy
interface.signature: def run_backtrader_strategy(strategy_module: str, data_path: Path, output_log: Path, params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: int = 300) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess

tests.standards: pytest-based testing. Mock subprocess.run for unit tests. Integration tests require both frameworks installed.

ideas.idea: Test timeout parameter passed to subprocess.run
Integration test: execute both frameworks, verify log files created
